politicalContributionTaxCredit.inputLine: ON479 line 15 / line 63110 for Ontario political contributions made in 2025; Worksheet ON479 uses this amount as its tier input.
politicalContributionTaxCredit.formula: If total contributions are 3793 or more, ON479 line 16 is 1666.82. Otherwise choose the Worksheet ON479 tier by contribution amount, calculate max(0, amount - subtract) * rate + add, and respect the ON479 maximum of 1666.82.

salaryWageRules.formula: total eligible expenditures for all students * 0.25
total eligible expenditures for all students * 0.30

For each qualifying placement: line1 = eligible expenditures * 0.25; line3 = eligible expenditures * 0.05; line6 = max(0, salariesAndWages2024 - 400000); line8 = line6 / 200000; line11 = max(0, 1 - line8); line13 = min(line1 + line3 * line11, 3000). Enter total claimed for all qualifying work placements on ON479 line 20.

onBen.status: Application form captured as part of the 2025 package. ON-BEN is not a deterministic entitlement worksheet; do not calculate Ontario Trillium Benefit or Ontario Senior Homeowners' Property Tax Grant amounts from unofficial sources.
onBen.paymentBoundary: ON-BEN states payments for these benefits are issued separately from the tax refund.
onBen.spouseOrCommonLawPartnerApplicationRule: If the taxpayer had a spouse or common-law partner on December 31, 2025, only one of them can apply for OEPTC, NOEC, and OSHPTG for both of them. If only one spouse or common-law partner was 64 years of age or older on December 31, 2025, that spouse or common-law partner must apply for those credits and the grant for both of them.

applicationLines.name: Ontario energy and property tax credit application
applicationLines.action: Tick if the 2026 OEPTC conditions apply and complete Part A and Part B.

applicationLines.name: Northern Ontario energy credit application
applicationLines.action: Tick if the 2026 NOEC Northern Ontario conditions apply and complete Part A and Part B.

applicationLines.name: Delayed single Ontario Trillium Benefit payment choice
applicationLines.action: Tick to wait until June 2027 to receive the 2026 OTB entitlement in one payment instead of monthly payments from July 2026 to June 2027.

applicationLines.name: Ontario senior homeowners' property tax grant application
applicationLines.action: Tick if age and ownership/occupancy/property-tax conditions apply; enter property tax on line 61120 and complete Part B.

applicationLines.name: Separate principal residences for medical reasons
applicationLines.action: Tick if the taxpayer and spouse or common-law partner occupied separate principal residences for medical reasons and the taxpayer chooses to apply individually for OEPTC, NOEC, or OSHPTG; enter spouse or common-law partner address in Part C.

applicationLines.name: Rent paid for principal residence
applicationLines.action: Enter total rent paid for principal residence in Ontario for 2025, including a private long-term care home, subject to the form's property-tax condition.

applicationLines.name: Property tax paid for principal residence
applicationLines.action: Enter total property tax actually paid for the principal residence in Ontario for 2025.

applicationLines.name: Designated student residence
applicationLines.action: Tick if the taxpayer resided in a designated student residence in Ontario in 2025.

applicationLines.name: Home energy costs on reserve
applicationLines.action: Enter home energy costs paid for the principal residence on a reserve in Ontario for 2025.

applicationLines.name: Public or non-profit long-term care home accommodation
applicationLines.action: Enter accommodation paid for a public or non-profit long-term care home in Ontario for 2025.

onBen.partC: Spouse or common-law partner address for involuntary separation where the medical-reasons condition applies.

rounding.policy: Use official form and guide rounding instructions at the line level. Preserve official whole-dollar constants and line-level clamps such as 'if negative, enter 0'.
rounding.openItem: No Ontario-specific global rounding shortcut was located in this pass.

lateFilingPenalty2025.standard: 5% of 2025 balance owing plus 1% for each full month late, up to 12 months
lateFilingPenalty2025.repeated: 10% of 2025 balance owing plus 2% for each full month late, up to 20 months, when the official previous-penalty and demand-to-file conditions apply

interest.balanceOwing: CRA charges compound daily interest starting the day after the due date.
interest.rates: CRA interest rates can change every three months.
interest.instalmentPenaltyBoundary: CRA applies an instalment penalty only if instalment interest for 2026 is more than $1,000.
